title: Crochet Bunny
description: A simple soft toy with a rounded body, long ears, and stitched facial details.
expectationText: A gentle amigurumi project that teaches you to shape basic body parts, stuff them evenly, and assemble a simple character cleanly.

steps.title: Start the body
steps.instruction: Begin with a magic ring and place a marker to track each round.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 6 single crochet into the ring.

steps.title: Increase for shape
steps.instruction: Increase evenly over the next rounds until the body reaches the widest point.

steps.title: Work even
steps.instruction: Crochet several rounds with no increases to build height before stuffing lightly.

steps.title: Decrease to close
steps.instruction: Use invisible decreases to taper the top and close the body after stuffing firmly.

steps.title: Add ears and face
steps.instruction: Crochet two simple ear pieces, sew them on, then stitch the eyes and nose.
